name: Renu Thakkar
quote: We plugged Caseily tracking into our Shopify store and "where is my order?" tickets dropped by 60% in the first month. Customers love the live status page.

name: Arjun Mehta
quote: Handling 3,000+ AWBs daily across Delhivery and BlueDart — Caseily normalises all the scan events into one clean timeline. Our ops dashboard finally makes sense.

name: Priya Sharma
quote: Our customers used to call us every day asking about their orders. Now they just check the tracking page. Onboarding was seamless — took less than an afternoon.

name: Vikram Singh
quote: The API is incredibly stable and the webhook responses are near-instant. We have integrated it across our entire custom ERP with zero downtime.

name: Neha Patel
quote: What used to take 3 support agents to track down missing parcels now takes seconds. The unified tracking interface is a game-changer for our B2B ops.

name: Sneha R.
quote: Got my phone case delivered in 3 days! The tracking page showed every step — from warehouse to my doorstep. So much better than checking the courier's janky site.

name: Karthik V.
quote: Love how I can see the exact location of my package. Got a notification when it was out for delivery. The case itself is gorgeous too — perfect fit on my iPhone.

name: Anjali P.
quote: Ordered a custom case and was anxious about delivery time. The live tracker calmed my nerves — I could see it moving across the country. Great experience overall!

name: Rohit K.
quote: The timeline was spot on. I knew exactly when to be home to receive my parcel. No more waiting around all day guessing when the delivery guy will show up.

name: Meera M.
quote: Usually I have to copy-paste tracking numbers across 3 different sites. This is so much easier. Just enter the number and boom, the whole history is right there.

name: Rahul S.
quote: Fast updates! The moment my package was out for delivery, the status changed. Really reassuring when you're ordering expensive items.
